create_ChunkedGenerator: create a ChunkedGenerator for batched training data with padded 2D poses and optional 3D ground truth
create_UnchunkedGenerator: create an UnchunkedGenerator for non-batched inference with per-sequence padding and optional augmentation
run_ChunkedGenerator_next_epoch: run ChunkedGenerator.next_epoch to yield batches of camera, 3D pose, and 2D keypoint data for training
run_UnchunkedGenerator_next_epoch: run UnchunkedGenerator.next_epoch to yield padded sequences for testing with optional horizontal flip augmentation
test_ChunkedGenerator_num_frames: test ChunkedGenerator.num_frames to compute total frames across all training batches
